definitions.explanation: The division of land or building units for sale to individual buyers. Used especially for condominiums and housing developments sold to individual owners.

examples.japanese: {分譲|ぶんじょう}マンションを{購入|こうにゅう}した。
examples.english: I purchased a condominium unit (for ownership).

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}{分譲|ぶんじょう}{住宅|じゅうたく}が{販売|はんばい}{中|ちゅう}だ。
このエリアは{分譲|ぶんじょう}{地|ち}として{開発|かいはつ}された。
examples.english: This area was developed as subdivided lots for sale.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{分|ぶん} (divide, portion) + {譲|じょう} (transfer, cede)

VERB FORM:
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}する (to subdivide and sell)

CONTRAST WITH RENTAL:
・{分譲|ぶんじょう} (for-sale, ownership) ↔ {賃貸|ちんたい} (rental)
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}マンション (owned condo) ↔ {賃貸|ちんたい}マンション (rental apartment)

COMMON COMPOUND TERMS:
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}マンション (condominium for purchase)
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}{住宅|じゅうたく} (housing for sale)
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}{地|ち} (subdivided lot for sale)
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}{価格|かかく} (sale price)
・{新築|しんちく}{分譲|ぶんじょう} (new for-sale properties)

BUYING VS RENTING:
In Japan, {分譲|ぶんじょう} properties offer:
・Long-term ownership
・Greater renovation freedom
・Building equity
・But require {修繕|しゅうぜん}{積立金|つみたてきん} (repair reserve) payments

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}を{検討|けんとう}する (to consider buying)
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}に{住|す}む (to live in owned property)
・{分譲|ぶんじょう}{価格|かかく}が{上|あ}がる (sale prices go up)
